id.description: The part id, equal to its folder name.

does.description: One line on what the flag does.

default.description: A value, or a condition that gives one.

needs.description: Flags that must all run for this one to run.

needs_any.description: Flags of which one must run for this one to run.

relevant_if.description: When false, the flag is hidden. It never turns the flag off.

signals.description: Signal names the handler logs for this flag.

text.description: A text file in the part's folder, for an instruction.

privacy.description: guard: a project file may raise it but never lower it, and a guarded list adds up over the scopes. loosens: on makes the checks weaker, so a project file may only set it off. A child of a guarded node is guarded unless it says otherwise.

stage.description: Marks an untested part or flag. A beta flag must default off, a beta part is never offered, and the doors show it in a group named "Beta, untested". A child takes its parent's stage.

offer_when.description: When true, a part that is off is offered.

handlers.description: The events the part's handler.py takes, with the tools it watches.

runs_in.description: The tools the handler runs in, when fewer than the part's. Leave it out to run where the part runs.

reason_not_in.description: One line per tool the flag does not run in.

requires.description: Programs, systems and lowest tool versions the part needs.

keeps_on_uninstall.description: Names of folders and files in hub's state folder that belong to the user, so hubctl uninstall keeps them.

range.description: The lowest and the highest value a number takes.

check.description: A check on the value of a text option. "pattern" means a regular expression that is not empty.

commands.description: hubctl commands the part adds, by name. A name may not be a core verb.

script.description: The script in the part's folder that runs.

jobs.description: Background jobs the part needs. Each runs one of the part's scripts while its flag runs, and hubctl apply and uninstall install and remove them.

name.description: The job's name, unique over all parts.

flag.description: The flag id that must run for the job to be installed.

script.description: A script in the part's folder.

every_seconds.description: Seconds between runs, or the id of a number flag that holds them.

start.description: Arguments for one run of the script when the job is first installed.

stop.description: Arguments for one run of the script after the job is removed.

id.description: The last segment of the flag id.
